en.description: Create one GPT Image 2.5 still from a written brief or from one to four reference images. GPT Image 2.5 Studio uses GPT-Image-2.5 Flare (gpt-image-2.5-flare) or GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst) for ChatGPT Images 2.5 text to image and reference-guided pictures. Make posters, product stills, infographics, social crops, and campaign frames with readable on-image type.
